item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 43 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 43 #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:00 AM 06 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Aroroy, Baleno, CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Uson, Dimasalang, Palanas, Cataingan, PioV.Corpuz, SanPascual, Claveria), #OrientalMindoro(SanTeodoro, Baco, Naujan, Bansud, Gloria, Bulalacao, Victoria, Socorro, Pola, Pinamalayan, PuertoGalera), #Marinduque(Buenavista, Torrijos and Gasan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Balud, Mandaon, Milagros, Cawayan, Placer, Esperanza), #Romblon, #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Bongabong, Roxas and Mansalay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
